skill.summary: Linode (Akamai) — compute instances, volumes, networking, NodeBalancers, domains, and Kubernetes.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Adds Linode (Akamai) management CLI.

- Manage compute instances: create, list, boot, reboot, shutdown, delete, and get details
- Manage volumes, NodeBalancers, domains, domain records, firewalls, and Kubernetes (LKE) clusters
- Retrieve account info, regions, instance types, and images
- Outputs data in JSON format
- Requires Python 3.10+ and a Linode API token (LINODE_TOKEN)
